analysis: The stretch that started 29 July was genuinely good — two nights of 7h 30m and then an 8h 5m on the third night, with that 31 July being the clear highlight: nearly 50 minutes of deep sleep, almost two hours of REM, and only 31 minutes awake. That is a well-rested body doing exactly what it's supposed to do. The back half of the week dipped though — you haven't cracked 7h 15m since, and that 6h 30m on the 1st was the low point, with deep sleep falling to just 27 minutes. Your REM has stayed impressively consistent all week, hovering around 1h 33m to 1h 48m every single night, which tells me the wind-down routine is doing something real — the body knows how to drop into the good stuff, it just needs a bit more total time to do it in.
